purpose: Calibration feasibility assessment for all 27 OPS-01 parent products with nonlinearity analysis

calibration_formula.description: Sentinel-1 Level-1 GRD radiometric calibration for detected products

dn_semantics.parent_product_pixel: Detected amplitude (multi-looked sqrt(I^2+Q^2)), stored as uint16
dn_semantics.ops01_crop_pixel: 10x10 spatial block mean of parent detected amplitude values, stored as float32
dn_semantics.consistent_with: Amplitude (uint16 range), NOT intensity (would be ~4e9 range)

nonlinearity_analysis.problem_statement: OPS-01 stores mean(DN). Calibration uses DN^2. By Jensen's inequality, (mean(DN))^2 != mean(DN^2).

error_sources.magnitude: ~6.2% in homogeneous regions (CV^2 where CV~0.25 for ENL=4.4)
notes: Bias = CV^2 / (1 + CV^2) where CV is within-block coefficient of variation
In dB: 10*log10(1.062) = 0.26 dB, within Sentinel-1 radiometric accuracy (0.34 dB)
Feature boundaries: CV >> 0.25, bias can reach 25-100%
Bias is SYSTEMATIC (same sign, same physics) across all scenes
NOT correctable from block-mean alone; requires raw parent pixels

nonlinearity_analysis.conclusion: Approximate calibration removes dominant 17% cross-swath confound at cost of ~6% systematic underestimate. Bias is constant offset in log domain. Acceptable for segmentation, not for absolute radiometry.
nonlinearity_analysis.validation_method: Read raw 10x10 parent pixels via /vsicurl/ range request, compute exact vs approximate sigma0

recovery_method.source: AWS S3 public Sentinel-1 Level-1C archive

crop_to_parent_mapping.example: source_window: row=15410..17970, col=50..2610 -> crop pixel (r,c) maps to parent line=15410+r*10, pixel=50+c*10

decision: CALIBRATION APPROXIMATELY RECONSTRUCTABLE BUT ERROR NOT FULLY ESTABLISHED
